appToken.description: Label for the user's Ace Data Cloud application token.

taskId.description: Label for the ID used to look up an existing music job.

find.description: Button to retrieve a task and list its available audio tracks.

create.description: Heading that opens the optional music generation form.

prompt.description: Label for a text description of the music the user wants.

cost.defaultMessage: Generation uses your Ace application credits. You can listen before adding a track.
cost.description: Billing notice above the button that submits a new generation.

generate.description: Button that explicitly starts a paid ACE Music generation.

getToken.description: Link to the Ace Data Cloud application console.

tokenRequired.defaultMessage: Enter your Ace application token first.
tokenRequired.description: Shown before submission if the token field is empty.

accepted.defaultMessage: Task accepted. Save its ID and use Find tracks to check the original task.
accepted.description: Success message after the service returns a new task ID.

uncertain.defaultMessage: Submission was not confirmed. Check your Ace task history before retrying.
uncertain.description: Recovery instruction when it is uncertain whether the request was accepted.

searching.description: Progress message while retrieving an existing task.

results.description: Lookup summary. State is the service's status and count is how many tracks can be previewed.

insert.description: Button for inserting the selected audio track into the current design.

inserted.description: Confirmation after the editor inserts an audio track.

insertFailed.defaultMessage: Could not add this track to the design.
insertFailed.description: Error shown when the editor cannot import selected audio.

lookupFailed.defaultMessage: Task lookup failed. Check your token and the original task ID.

unsupported.defaultMessage: This design type does not support audio tracks.
unsupported.description: Shown when the current Canva design cannot contain audio tracks.

durationMissing.defaultMessage: This track has no usable duration.
durationMissing.description: Shown when the service omitted audio duration required by Canva.
